parties.petitioner: Fertilizer Corporation of India Limited & Ors.

summary: Maintainability of civil suit against sick industrial company; Section 22(1) of Sick Industrial Companies (Special Provisions) Act, 1985 prohibits legal proceedings during BIFR reference; recovery suit for non-admitted debt barred; statutory bar applies regardless of debt nature; 24% compound interest disallowed; standard interest rate applied; suspension of proceedings mandatory; HC erred in allowing appeal against ex parte decree; suit dismissed as coram non-judice; decretal amount interest capped under Civil Procedure Code.
legal_provisions_cited: Sick Industrial Companies (Special Provisions) Act, 1985 s.3(1)(o)
Sick Industrial Companies (Special Provisions) Act, 1985 s.22(1)
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; trial court decree restored; respondent's suit dismissed as not maintainable under SICA 1985.
